coverage.category: 1. Household employers: domestic workers, live-in carers, nannies
coverage.found: No Burkina-specific rule for domestic workers found; general CNSS registration duty (Code de sécurité sociale arts 3 and 24, Cour de cassation arrêt 044/2020). CNSS found 4,800+ unregistered workers in 2025 and plans to inspect 16,916 employers in 2026 (https://fr.allafrica.com/stories/202606080704.html). Same buyer/duty as K04 for small employers; nothing new for households.

coverage.category: 2. Scrap-metal dealers
coverage.found: No Burkina scrap-dealer register, licence or order found (search returned only Niger, Djibouti, France). Unverified whether a regime exists.

coverage.category: 3. Second-hand dealers and pawnbrokers
coverage.found: No pawnbroker or second-hand dealer regime found. A May 2026 claim of a ban on second-hand clothing imports was fact-checked as false (https://africacheck.org/fr/fact-checks/meta-programme-fact-checks/faux-le-burkina-faso-na-pas-interdit-limportation-de).

coverage.category: 4. Gold and jewellery buyers
coverage.found: Comptoirs d'or are regulated by decree 2006-29 and interministerial order 2009-001, with a trade body CCOMP/BF (2021). Export permits for artisanal gold were suspended in Feb 2024 and the state buyer SONASP now purchases artisanal output, which squeezes private comptoirs. Candidate C06 (weak).

coverage.category: 5. Used car parts and vehicle dismantlers
coverage.found: No casse-auto or dismantler licensing found; only general business creation guidance (africarrieres). Nothing new.

coverage.category: 6. Livestock traders, markets and animal transport
coverage.found: Export special authorisations (ASE) were suspended by an interministerial communiqué of 8 May 2026 and about ten trucks were seized (https://fr.allafrica.com/stories/202605150138.html). Transport needs a health certificate and a zoo-sanitary laissez-passer. Volatile buyer pool, similar to the rejected K08. Candidate C07 (weak).

coverage.category: 7. Small abattoirs and butchers
coverage.found: Agence Faso Abattoir created in April 2025; new abattoirs are state-built; slaughter of donkeys, horses and camelids is governed by decree 2016-857 and law 048-2017/AN. No butcher register or licence text found.

coverage.category: 8. Beekeepers
coverage.found: No search spent; the budget went to categories with stronger signals.

coverage.category: 9. Veterinary practices and veterinary medicine sellers
coverage.found: Selling veterinary medicines needs an authorisation from the veterinary services (DGSV reminder, Sept 2025, with unregistered products seized in Ouagadougou). Legal base: decree 1997 on veterinary pharmacy, decree 2019-0461/PRES/PM/MRAH on private practice, law 048-2017/AN. COVEP is the private vets' body (June 2026 workshop on distribution circuits). Candidate C02 (weak).

coverage.category: 10. Well drillers and water abstraction
coverage.found: Decree 2007-485 requires every driller or rehabilitator to supply information on works; decree 2005-187 sets the nomenclature of installations needing authorisation or declaration. The driller files an arrêté and seven forms with the regional water directorate. No driller licence found. Small niche; folded into C08.

coverage.category: 11. Septic, sanitation and waste haulers
coverage.found: Sludge-removal operators are approved by the ministry: 20 applied and 12 were approved on 11 Jan 2024 (https://www.gouv.bj/article/2521/remise-agrements-operateurs-vidange-structures-outillees-gouvernement/ is a Benin page; the Burkina source is the Eawag/pS-Eau material and the 2024 ministry ceremony cited in search results). The Komsilga treatment station is due Sept 2026. Very small buyer pool. Candidate C08 (weak).

coverage.category: 12. Lift, boiler and pressure-equipment owners and inspectors
coverage.found: No Burkina decree or order on periodic inspection of lifts or pressure equipment found (results were French). Unverified whether one exists in the Labour Code decrees.

coverage.category: 13. Small water systems
coverage.found: No data found on private operators (délégataires) of simplified water supply systems (AEPS) or their reporting duties. Unverified.

coverage.category: 14. Pesticide and fertiliser dealers and applicators
coverage.found: Law 026-2017/AN on pesticide control and decree 2019-0509 of 22 May 2019 require an agrément for distributors, resellers, applicators, transporters and destroyers. The agrément is issued by the commerce minister on technical advice from agriculture, and a national pesticide committee (CNGP) exists. The decree page could not be fetched (403), so validity and record-keeping duties are unchecked. Candidate C05 (weak).

coverage.category: 15. Labour contractors and recruitment agencies
coverage.found: Private placement and temporary-work agencies need a labour-ministry agrément (decree 2007-548, order 2007-028). 92 agencies were approved on 15 Jan 2024 (88 in Ouagadougou), and the head of state attacked the pay-splitting model on 8 Jan 2024 (https://leconomistedufaso.com/?p=19305). Tiny buyer pool. Candidate C04 (weak).

coverage.category: 16. Cemeteries, burial societies and funeral services
coverage.found: No Burkina source found on funeral or cemetery regulation (results were France and Belgium). Unverified.

coverage.category: 17. Community and religious bodies: associations, charities, halal and kosher supervision
coverage.found: Strong signal. Law 011-2025/ALT of 17 July 2025 (promulgated 23 July 2025) replaced law 064-2015/CNT. The implementing decree of Nov 2025 covers declaration, renewal of the governing body, changes to statutes and utility recognition. Decree 2025-1440 of 11 Nov 2025 forces NGO and association accounts into a state bank. 118 associations were dissolved on 15 Apr 2026, and more than 1,100 had been suspended or dissolved by June 2026, mainly for not renewing their governing bodies. To regain status an association needs an attestation de renouvellement. Candidate C01. No halal or kosher supervision found.

coverage.category: 18. Transport operators: minibus, taxi, moto-taxi, small trucking and bus fleets
coverage.found: No current municipal permit rule for taxi or moto-taxi found (only a 2013 Bobo-Dioulasso dispute and an undated Ouagadougou taxi circulation card). DGTTM inspected bus stations and body shops in Dédougou on 25 Sept 2025. Nothing new beyond K03 for the motorbike side.

coverage.category: 19. Market traders, street vendors, money changers
coverage.found: Micro-enterprises fall under the CME regime (declarative for 5-15m FCFA turnover, flat-rate below 5m) and must issue a standardised invoice since 2022. Ouagadougou collects market fees through SYCOTAX. Money changers need a manual-exchange agrément under UEMOA regulation 09/2010/CM/UEMOA (regional). No Burkina bureau-de-change source found. Candidate C09 (weak, close to K01/K09).

coverage.category: 20. Small licensed premises with inspections: tattoo studios, driving schools, childminders and nurseries, small food producers, hunting outfitters
coverage.found: Driving schools: DGTTM closed 118 unauthorised schools between 7 Nov and 4 Dec 2023 and checks compliance with the cahier des charges (Sept 2025). Candidate C03. No source found for nurseries or childminders (private pre-schools: 139 unrecognised ones were found in 2018). Nothing searched for tattoo studios, food producers or hunting outfitters.

coverage.category: 24. Private clinics, labs and other health providers that bill insurers or state schemes
coverage.found: Strongest lead. AMU/RAMU (law 060-2015/CNT) care started 1 Feb 2026 in pilot regions; CNAMU opened a call (3-8 Aug 2026, now closed) to convention private clinics, pharmacies, labs, imaging, orthopaedic and device providers in 9 more regions. CNAMU pays invoices under conventions. Ministry of Health launched e-Agrément MS portal 7 Aug 2026 for private-clinic opening/modification files. No CNAMU-certified billing software found.

coverage.category: 25. Pharmacies, medicine importers, and users of controlled chemicals or precursors
coverage.found: Only old ministerial arrêtés (2005-2010) on officine/dépôt authorisation and transfer, personal authorisation, inspection before opening. Pharmacies are within the CNAMU convention call, so they fall under candidate C01. Nothing found on traceability, DGPML reporting, or controlled-chemical/precursor users (not searched specifically).

coverage.category: 26. Security, cleaning and manpower agencies, and the firms that hire their workers
coverage.found: Private security is governed by decree 2021-1243 of 29 Nov 2021 (managers need certified professional aptitude, art. 19); ARCOP rules on guarding tender specs (arrêté 2023-519/MEFP/CAB). Agrément, register and staff-declaration details not found. Cleaning and manpower agencies not searched.

coverage.category: 27. Construction, mining and quarry contractors and suppliers: site registers, accreditation, local-content reports
coverage.found: Decree 2021-1142 (local supply, binding from 1 Jan 2022), joint arrêté of 29 Dec 2023 (revised list of goods/services with minimum local shares), Law 017-2024/ALT on mining local content, and two implementing decrees adopted 12 Feb 2025 (fines scale, local-content fund). ABSM is the suppliers' federation. No official supplier register or reporting platform found. Quarries not specifically searched.

coverage.category: 28. Notaries, land agents, real estate brokers and other professionals with periodic or anti-money-laundering reports
coverage.found: AML/CFT law 046-2024/ALT (30 Dec 2024); notaries' order trained members Jul 2025; no detail on thresholds or forms found. Real estate: promotion law 2023 (legal entities only, agrément from ONC/AC) and an inter-ministerial arrêté of 8 Apr 2026 creating a professional card for démarcheurs (about 57,400 people per an agency head; text not seen). No public register of agencies found.

coverage.category: 29. Hotels, guest houses and short-term rentals: guest registers, tourism levies
coverage.found: No Burkina guest-register or tourist-levy text found. Annual homologation list of hotels and travel agencies (2019: 212 hotels, 160 agencies) conditions access to public contracts. Direction générale du tourisme surveyed furnished apartments in Ouagadougou from 30 Jun 2025 and ordered regularisation. Immigration forms went online at borders on 8 Apr 2026 (not for hotels).

coverage.category: 30. Small exporters and importers facing traceability or certification rules: food, fish, timber, forest-risk commodities
coverage.found: Only cereal flour export reopening (ASE, Jul 2026) touched. Timber, fish, shea and cotton not searched; sesame and cashew SPS are already K08 (rejected).

coverage.category: 31. AMU (RAMU) employer affiliation and contributions
coverage.found: CNAMU affiliation of employers began 29 Oct 2024 nationwide, open to every employer of salaried workers; a pilot had enrolled 431 structures (216 private) by early 2026. A private guide says 2.5% employer and 2.5% employee contributions (unconfirmed, no official text seen). No online platform mentioned in the communiqué.

coverage.category: 32. Microfinance law 001-2025/ALT conversion of caisses
coverage.found: See category 23; caisses populaires converting to sociétés coopératives de microfinance; paid-order instruments abolished; share raised e.g. 2,000 to 5,000 FCFA at Manga.

coverage.category: 33. Artisanal gold mining co-operatives and gold buying under the 2024 mining code
coverage.found: Mining code law 016-2024/ALT makes a co-operative (SCOOP) a precondition for the artisanal exploitation authorisation; mining artisan card for Burkinabe individuals; SONASP (successor of ANEEMAS since Oct 2023) buys gold via counters at Bobo-Dioulasso, Gaoua and Banfora; illegal buying offices were closed in 2025; SONASP collected about 29 t by 30 Jun 2026. Buyers are low-digital and state-led.

coverage.category: 34. Private health facility authorisation: e-Agrément MS
coverage.found: Portal launched 7 Aug 2026 for opening/operation/modification files of private health facilities and NGO partnership conventions. Portal address and user guide not found.

coverage.category: 35. Real-estate promoters and démarcheurs (law 2023, arrêté April 2026)
coverage.found: Promoters must be legal entities with an ONC/AC agrément; the DG said in 2023 none was fully compliant; démarcheurs now get a professional card (arrêté 8 Apr 2026, summary only).

coverage.category: 36. Agricultural warehouse managers under the warehouse-receipt law 040-2023/ALT
coverage.found: Same source as category 22; manager approval, insurance and fire standards debated in committee; final provisions and decrees unchecked.
